notes: These evaluations assess response quality when the skill is invoked; they do not prove routing, registry state, or automatic enforcement. Semantic role selection and WCAG non-text applicability remain agent judgments. Any Wada query requires user-supplied external data.

evals.name: choose-and-measure-success-role
evals.prompt: For a corporate finance interface, choose which of two supplied colors is a more suitable success-status fill and explain the semantic reason. Treat pattern ranges as candidate guidance, not an engine recommendation. If normal text is placed on the chosen fill, measure that actual text/fill pair and report the applicable result.
evals.expected_output: The agent chooses a success role and explains its reason based on interface meaning; it does not claim the engine selected a semantic role. Every stated numeric contrast comes from the engine, and a fill-role choice is not represented as proof that text on that fill passes.

evals.name: measure-scale-candidate-for-aaa
evals.prompt: Text #999999 on #FFFFFF fails normal-text contrast. Measure the pair, generate its OKLCH scale, then measure a scale candidate against white for AAA normal text. Report a selected candidate and its measured ratio; if no available candidate meets 7:1, report that limitation without claiming PASS.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses scale and contrast instead of claiming automatic adjustment. The current pair is reported as 2.85:1; any candidate ratio is measured with the engine. If no candidate meets 7:1, the agent reports that no available candidate meets the target and does not fabricate PASS.

evals.name: external-wada-query
evals.prompt: Given an explicitly supplied, authorized Wada-compatible dataset, query a palette ID and a multiword color name. Report results in dataset order, distinguish source colors from semantic UI roles, and state if a query has no matches.
evals.expected_output: The agent passes the supplied dataset explicitly with --dataset, reports only values returned from that file, preserves result order, and does not imply the dataset is bundled or licensed by this package.

evals.name: nontext-contrast-context
evals.prompt: Measure a supplied accent color against its adjacent background. Decide whether it conveys required information for an active control/state or meaningful icon, or is only decorative/inactive. Explain WCAG 1.4.11 applicability and the 3:1 threshold without treating a large-text flag as a complete non-text verdict.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the numeric pair from the engine, states the contextual applicability judgment separately, and does not infer non-text conformance from a numeric flag alone. Decorative content and inactive controls are distinguished from required active-state or meaningful-icon information.
